test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which of the following Australian cities did the Indian External Affairs Minister inaugurate India's 4th consulate in November 2024?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Brisbane**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian **External Affairs Minister** inaugurated India’s 4th consulate in Brisbane in **November 2024**.
 
• The establishment of the consulate reflects **India’s growing diplomatic presence** in Australia.
 
• Brisbane is the **capital city of Queensland**, one of the largest states in Australia, and is known for its **economic significance** and **cultural diversity**.
 
• The city has a vibrant Indian diaspora, and the new consulate will serve their **administrative and consular needs**.
 
• The consulate will also enhance **bilateral relations** between India and Australia in sectors such as **trade, education, and cultural exchange**.
 
• India’s diplomatic footprint in Australia now includes consulates in **Melbourne, Sydney, Perth, and Brisbane**, along with the High Commission in Canberra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Perth**__

 __
 
• **Perth** is the capital of Western Australia and is known for its **mining and natural resource industries**.
 
• India already has a consulate established in Perth to cater to the needs of the Indian diaspora in Western Australia.
 
 
 
• **Melbourne**__
 __
 
• **Melbourne** is renowned for its **education sector** and has a significant number of Indian students pursuing higher education.
 
• India’s consulate in Melbourne supports consular services for Victoria and Tasmania.
 
 
 
• **Sydney**__
 
 
• **Sydney** is Australia’s largest city and a major hub for **financial and cultural activities**.
 
• India’s consulate in Sydney handles consular services for New South Wales and serves a large Indian community.
